text:
phil: Vendor just flagged eu-west1 standby pool propagation issues  some standby instances aren't registering for our autoscaler, starting ~2024-11-08 02:00 UTC. They say its a control-plane propagation lag, not capacity yet, but it could cause the autoscaler to spin extra cross-region fallback. Link: https://vendor.portal/incidents/PROP-9087
anya: Got it. Do we know which projects saw the duplicate cross-region fallbacks? I saw a couple of strange us-central spins in the overnight run.
mike: I saw two: proj-sweeps-9 and proj-cron-11 both had fallback instances in us-central despite free standby in EU. Logs show the instance registration event delayed ~80s.
infra-bot: [alert] autoscaler detected registration_timeout for 2 instances in eu-west1 for projects [proj-sweeps-9, proj-cron-11]. Suggested mitigation: increase registration_window to 120s or prefer standby-validated pools. Docs: https://internal.redwood/autoscaler/registration
phil: Short-term options: 1) increase registration_window to 120s (quick config flip), 2) tag noisy short jobs as "defer-during-prop" so they don't trigger cross-region fallback, 3) ask vendor to expedite control-plane fix. Thoughts?
anya: I'd prefer config flip + tagging. Tagging prevents churn and avoids cross-region egress. Can we do a canary on proj-sweeps-9?
mike: I'll open a tiny infra PR to add the tag and bump registration_window in runtime config for autoscaler. Snippet in the PR: ```
# runtime overrides
autoscaler:
  registration_window_seconds: 120
project_tags:
  proj-sweeps-9:
    - defer-during-prop
```
phil: Also open a support request asking vendor to mark proj-ci-main as protected from fallback for the next 4h in case propagation regresses. We don't want CI to unexpectedly run in another region.
vendor-bot: Support ticket PROP-9087 created and escalated. We can apply a temporary protection to 1 project per account for propagation incidents. Please reply with the project name to attach. ETA for action: ~45-75 mins.
anya: Replying now with proj-ci-main. If vendor denies, we'll instead set `prefer_region = eu-west1` on proj-ci-main to avoid cross-region fallback (risky, but better than unexpected egress).
mike: PR link: https://github.com/redwood/infrastructure/pull/4356 (draft). It updates runtime override and adds the tag to proj-sweeps-9 only for canary. Will not apply until we get green from canary.
infra-bot: Canary started: job ci-45321 for proj-sweeps-9 launched 2024-11-08T02:12:00Z. Monitoring registration events.
mike: Canary result: registration delay reduced effect  job waited ~95s and landed in EU standby pool after registration_window increase; no cross-region fallback.
phil: Nice. Hold bulk tag apply until vendor confirms protection for proj-ci-main. If protection isn't granted within 60m, we'll flip prefer_region for CI and add a note to billing to track egress.
anya: Also let's add an alert suppression rule for spurious autoscaler pages while we observe propagation; silence for 2 hours. I'll file the suppression.
vendor-bot: Update: protection applied to proj-ci-main for 3 hours (ticket PROP-9087). Closing in ~3 hours unless extended.
phil: OK thanks. I'll merge and apply the canary-only PR now and schedule the wider rollout after 30m observation. Anyone object?
mike: lgtm. I'll watch telemetry and revert if we see registration_timeouts increase.
anya: Thanks team. I'll post a short note in #general to let EU devs know about possible delayed job starts this morning and the mitigation steps.
